column2:
caffeine(n.)咖啡因
caffeinated(adj.)含咖啡因的
decaffeinated(adj.)去除咖啡因的
caffeine intake 咖啡因攝取量
caffeine-free 不含咖啡因的
Drinking too much caffeine late at night can make it hard to fall asleep.
(深夜攝取過多咖啡因會讓人難以入睡。)
Many students rely on caffeine to stay awake while studying for exams.
(許多學生在準備考試時依賴咖啡因來保持清醒。)

calculator(n.)計算機
calculate(v.)計算
calculation(n.)計算
scientific calculator 工程用計算機
pocket calculator 口袋型計算機
Students are not allowed to use calculators on the math section of the exam.
(學生在考試的數學部分不准使用計算機。)
She quickly added up the bill on her calculator.
(她用計算機很快地算出帳單總額。)

calligraphy(n.)書法
calligrapher(n.)書法家
Chinese calligraphy 中國書法
practice calligraphy 練書法
My grandfather practices Chinese calligraphy every morning to calm his mind.
(我爺爺每天早上練書法來沉澱心情。)
The art exhibition features beautiful works of calligraphy from the Tang Dynasty.
(這場藝術展展出唐朝優美的書法作品。)

cape(n.)海角、岬、披肩、斗篷
(無詞性變化)
Cape of Good Hope 好望角
red cape 紅色斗篷
Eluanbi is a famous cape at the southern tip of Taiwan.
(鵝鑾鼻是位於台灣最南端的著名海角。)
In the movie, the superhero wears a long red cape.
(電影中，那位超級英雄披著一件長長的紅色斗篷。)

capsule(n.)膠囊、太空艙
(無詞性變化)
time capsule 時光膠囊
space capsule 太空艙
Our class buried a time capsule to be opened in twenty years.
(我們班埋了一個時光膠囊，二十年後再打開。)
Take one capsule with water after each meal.
(每餐飯後配水服用一顆膠囊。)

caption(n./v.)(圖片的)說明文字、字幕、加上說明
(無詞性變化)
photo caption 照片說明
write a caption 寫說明文字
She spent ten minutes thinking of a clever caption for her Instagram post.
(她花了十分鐘想一句巧妙的文字搭配她的 Instagram 貼文。)
The photo was captioned 'Sunset over Tamsui River.'
(這張照片的說明文字是「淡水河上的夕陽」。)

captive(adj./n.)被俘虜的、被關住的、俘虜
captivity(n.)囚禁
captivate(v.)迷住
hold someone captive 囚禁某人
captive audience 不得不聽的聽眾
The rebels held the journalists captive for three months.
(叛軍將那些記者囚禁了三個月。)
Passengers on a long flight are a captive audience for advertisers.
(長途班機上的乘客是廣告商無處可逃的觀眾。)

captivity(n.)囚禁、圈養
captive(adj./n.)被俘的、俘虜
in captivity 被囚禁、被圈養
release from captivity 從囚禁中釋放
Animals born in captivity may not survive if released into the wild.
(圈養出生的動物若被野放，可能無法存活。)
The hostages were finally released after two years of captivity.
(人質在被囚禁兩年後終於獲釋。)

cardboard(n.)硬紙板、厚紙板
(無詞性變化)
cardboard box 紙箱
recycle cardboard 回收紙板
We packed all our books into cardboard boxes before moving.
(搬家前我們把所有的書裝進紙箱。)
The students built a model city out of recycled cardboard.
(學生們用回收的厚紙板搭建了一座模型城市。)

cardinal(n./adj.)樞機主教、紅雀、基本的、首要的
(無詞性變化)
cardinal rule 基本原則
cardinal number 基數
The cardinal rule of science is that results must be tested and repeated.
(科學的基本原則是結果必須經過檢驗並可重複。)
A cardinal is a senior official in the Catholic Church.
(樞機主教是天主教會的高階神職人員。)

carefree(adj.)無憂無慮的
(無詞性變化)
carefree days 無憂無慮的日子
carefree childhood 無憂無慮的童年
I often think back to the carefree days of my childhood.
(我常常回想起童年無憂無慮的日子。)
The students looked relaxed and carefree after their final exams.
(期末考結束後，學生們看起來放鬆又無憂無慮。)

caretaker(n.)看護、照顧者、管理員
(無詞性變化)
full-time caretaker 全職照顧者
school caretaker 學校工友
After her father's stroke, she became his full-time caretaker.
(她父親中風後，她成了他的全職照顧者。)
The caretaker locks the school gate every night at ten.
(管理員每晚十點鎖上校門。)

carton(n.)紙盒、紙箱
(無詞性變化)
milk carton 牛奶紙盒
a carton of eggs 一盒蛋
Please rinse the milk carton before putting it in the recycling bin.
(把牛奶紙盒放進回收桶前請先沖洗乾淨。)
Mom asked me to buy a carton of eggs on my way home.
(媽媽要我回家路上買一盒蛋。)

cashier(n.)收銀員、出納員
cash(n./v.)現金、兌現
pay the cashier 付錢給收銀員
cashier counter 收銀台
Please pay the cashier at the front of the store.
(請到店門口的收銀台付款。)
She works part-time as a cashier at a convenience store.
(她在便利商店兼職當收銀員。)

casualty(n.)傷亡人員、受害者
casual(adj.)偶然的、非正式的
heavy casualties 慘重的傷亡
casualty figures 傷亡人數
The earthquake caused heavy casualties in the mountain villages.
(那場地震在山區村莊造成慘重傷亡。)
Small businesses were the first casualties of the economic crisis.
(小型企業是這次經濟危機的首批受害者。)

catastrophe(n.)大災難、災禍
catastrophic(adj.)災難性的
natural catastrophe 天災
environmental catastrophe 環境浩劫
Scientists warn that rising sea levels could lead to a global catastrophe.
(科學家警告海平面上升可能導致全球性大災難。)
The oil spill was an environmental catastrophe for the coastline.
(這次漏油事件對海岸線而言是一場環境浩劫。)

cater(v.)提供餐飲、迎合、滿足需要
catering(n.)外燴
caterer(n.)外燴業者
cater to 迎合、滿足
cater a party 為派對提供外燴
The restaurant caters to customers who prefer vegetarian food.
(這家餐廳迎合偏好素食的顧客。)
A local company catered the wedding banquet.
(一家當地公司承辦了這場婚宴的餐飲。)

caterpillar(n.)毛毛蟲
(無詞性變化)
hungry caterpillar 好餓的毛毛蟲
caterpillar stage 幼蟲階段
A caterpillar eventually turns into a beautiful butterfly.
(毛毛蟲最終會變成美麗的蝴蝶。)
The caterpillars ate almost all the leaves on the lemon tree.
(毛毛蟲幾乎吃光了檸檬樹上所有的葉子。)

cavity(n.)蛀牙、蛀洞、腔、洞
(無詞性變化)
dental cavity 蛀牙
chest cavity 胸腔
Eating too much sugar can cause cavities in your teeth.
(吃太多糖會導致蛀牙。)
The dentist found two cavities during my checkup.
(牙醫在檢查時發現我有兩顆蛀牙。)

celery(n.)芹菜
(無詞性變化)
celery stick 芹菜條
stir-fried celery 炒芹菜
Celery is low in calories and high in fiber.
(芹菜熱量低而且纖維含量高。)
She dipped a celery stick into the peanut butter.
(她把一根芹菜條沾上花生醬。)

cellular(adj.)細胞的、蜂巢式(行動)通訊的
cell(n.)細胞
cellular phone 行動電話
cellular structure 細胞結構
Scientists study the cellular structure of plants under a microscope.
(科學家在顯微鏡下研究植物的細胞結構。)
Cellular networks allow us to use the Internet almost anywhere.
(行動網路讓我們幾乎在任何地方都能上網。)

Celsius(n.)攝氏
(無詞性變化)
degrees Celsius 攝氏度
Celsius scale 攝氏溫標
Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
(在海平面，水在攝氏一百度沸騰。)
The temperature in Taipei reached 38 degrees Celsius yesterday.
(台北昨天的氣溫高達攝氏三十八度。)

cement(n./v.)水泥、黏合劑、鞏固
(無詞性變化)
cement floor 水泥地
cement a relationship 鞏固關係
The workers mixed sand and cement to make concrete.
(工人們把沙和水泥混合製成混凝土。)
The trip helped cement the friendship between the two classes.
(這趟旅行有助於鞏固兩班之間的友誼。)

census(n.)人口普查
(無詞性變化)
national census 全國人口普查
census data 人口普查資料
The government conducts a national census every ten years.
(政府每十年進行一次全國人口普查。)
According to census data, the population of the city is getting older.
(根據人口普查資料，這座城市的人口正在老化。)

ceramic(adj./n.)陶瓷的、陶瓷製品
ceramics(n.)陶瓷藝術、陶藝
ceramic tile 瓷磚
ceramic bowl 陶瓷碗
Yingge is famous for its handmade ceramic products.
(鶯歌以手工陶瓷製品聞名。)
The bathroom floor is covered with white ceramic tiles.
(浴室地板鋪著白色瓷磚。)

certify(v.)證明、認證、發證書給
certificate(n.)證書
certification(n.)認證
certified(adj.)經認證的
certified teacher 合格教師
certify as 認證為
This document certifies that you have completed the course.
(本文件證明你已修畢此課程。)
Only certified electricians are allowed to do this kind of work.
(只有合格的電工才能做這類工作。)

chairperson(n.)主席(性別中立)
chair(n.)主席
chairman(n.)主席(男)、董事長
chairwoman(n.)女主席
elect a chairperson 選出主席
chairman of the board 董事長
The committee elected a new chairperson at its first meeting.
(委員會在第一次會議中選出新主席。)
The chairman of the company announced his retirement yesterday.
(那家公司的董事長昨天宣布退休。)

champagne(n.)香檳酒
(無詞性變化)
a bottle of champagne 一瓶香檳
champagne toast 香檳舉杯慶祝
They opened a bottle of champagne to celebrate their victory.
(他們開了一瓶香檳慶祝勝利。)
Guests raised their glasses for a champagne toast to the newlyweds.
(賓客們舉起香檳杯向新人敬酒。)

chant(n./v.)反覆吟唱、呼口號、讚美詩
(無詞性變化)
chant slogans 呼口號
Buddhist chant 佛教誦經
The fans chanted the player's name as he walked onto the field.
(那位球員走進球場時，球迷們齊聲高喊他的名字。)
We could hear the monks chanting in the temple.
(我們能聽到僧侶在寺裡誦經。)

charitable(adj.)慈善的、寬厚的
charity(n.)慈善、慈善機構
charitable organization 慈善機構
charitable donation 慈善捐款
She donates part of her salary to charitable organizations every year.
(她每年把一部分薪水捐給慈善機構。)
Try to be charitable when judging other people's mistakes.
(評斷別人的錯誤時，試著寬厚一點。)

checkup(n.)健康檢查、檢查
check(v./n.)檢查
annual checkup 年度健康檢查
dental checkup 牙齒檢查
Doctors recommend getting a medical checkup at least once a year.
(醫生建議至少每年做一次健康檢查。)
I have a dental checkup next Monday afternoon.
(我下週一下午要做牙齒檢查。)

chemist(n.)化學家、藥劑師(英式)
chemistry(n.)化學
chemical(adj./n.)化學的、化學物質
research chemist 研究化學家
organic chemist 有機化學家
Marie Curie was a famous chemist who won two Nobel Prizes.
(居禮夫人是一位曾獲兩座諾貝爾獎的知名化學家。)
The chemist developed a new material that can absorb carbon dioxide.
(那位化學家開發出一種能吸收二氧化碳的新材料。)

chestnut(n./adj.)栗子、栗樹、栗色的
(無詞性變化)
roasted chestnuts 糖炒栗子
chestnut hair 栗色頭髮
The smell of roasted chestnuts filled the street in winter.
(冬天街上瀰漫著糖炒栗子的香味。)
The girl with chestnut hair is our new classmate.
(那位栗色頭髮的女孩是我們的新同學。)

chili(n.)辣椒
(無詞性變化)
chili sauce 辣椒醬
chili pepper 辣椒
He added a spoonful of chili sauce to his noodles.
(他在麵裡加了一湯匙辣椒醬。)
Thai food often uses fresh chili peppers and lime.
(泰國菜常使用新鮮辣椒和萊姆。)

chimpanzee(n.)黑猩猩
chimp(n.)黑猩猩(口語)
wild chimpanzee 野生黑猩猩
chimpanzee behavior 黑猩猩的行為
Jane Goodall spent decades studying wild chimpanzees in Africa.
(動物學家古德花了數十年在非洲研究野生黑猩猩。)
Chimpanzees are able to use simple tools to find food.
(黑猩猩能夠使用簡單的工具來找食物。)

chirp(n./v.)(鳥、蟲)啁啾聲、發出啁啾聲
chirpy(adj.)活潑快樂的
birds chirp 鳥兒啁啾
the chirp of crickets 蟋蟀的唧唧聲
I woke up to the sound of birds chirping outside my window.
(我在窗外鳥兒的啁啾聲中醒來。)
The chirp of crickets filled the quiet summer night.
(蟋蟀的唧唧聲充滿了寧靜的夏夜。)

cholesterol(n.)膽固醇
(無詞性變化)
high cholesterol 高膽固醇
cholesterol level 膽固醇濃度
Eating too much fried food can raise your cholesterol level.
(吃太多油炸食物會使膽固醇升高。)
The doctor advised him to eat more vegetables to lower his cholesterol.
(醫生建議他多吃蔬菜以降低膽固醇。)

cigar(n.)雪茄
cigarette(n.)香菸
smoke a cigar 抽雪茄
Cuban cigar 古巴雪茄
The old man sat on the porch, slowly smoking a cigar.
(那位老人坐在門廊上，慢慢地抽著雪茄。)
Cigar smoke filled the small room and made me cough.
(雪茄的煙霧充滿了小房間，嗆得我直咳嗽。)

civilize(v.)使文明、教化
civilization(n.)文明
civilized(adj.)文明的、有禮的
civilized society 文明社會
civilized behavior 有禮貌的行為
In a civilized society, people settle disputes through discussion rather than violence.
(在文明社會中，人們透過討論而非暴力解決爭端。)
Colonists once believed they had a duty to civilize other peoples, a view now widely criticized.
(殖民者曾認為自己有責任教化其他民族，這種觀點如今廣受批評。)

clam(n.)蛤蜊、蚌
(無詞性變化)
clam soup 蛤蜊湯
clam up 閉口不言
Mom made a pot of clam soup with ginger.
(媽媽煮了一鍋加薑的蛤蜊湯。)
Whenever the teacher asks about the broken window, he clams up.
(每當老師問起打破的窗戶，他就閉口不言。)

clasp(v./n.)緊握、扣住、扣環、緊握
(無詞性變化)
clasp one's hands 雙手緊握
necklace clasp 項鍊扣環
She clasped her hands together and prayed for her sick grandmother.
(她雙手緊握，為生病的奶奶祈禱。)
The clasp on my necklace broke, so I had to get it repaired.
(我項鍊的扣環壞了，所以得拿去修理。)

clearance(n.)清除、出清、許可、間隙
clear(v./adj.)清除、清楚的
clearance sale 清倉大拍賣
security clearance 安全許可
The department store is having a clearance sale this weekend.
(那家百貨公司這個週末舉辦清倉大拍賣。)
The pilot was waiting for clearance to take off.
(機長正在等待起飛許可。)

climax(n./v.)高潮、頂點、達到高潮
climactic(adj.)高潮的
reach a climax 達到高潮
the climax of the story 故事的高潮
The concert reached its climax when the band played their most famous song.
(樂團演奏他們最有名的歌曲時，音樂會達到高潮。)
The climax of the novel comes when the detective finally reveals the killer.
(小說的高潮出現在偵探終於揭露兇手的時候。)

clockwise(adv./adj.)順時針方向地、順時針方向的
counterclockwise(adv./adj.)逆時針方向地
turn clockwise 順時針轉
clockwise direction 順時針方向
Turn the knob clockwise to increase the volume.
(把旋鈕順時針轉以調高音量。)
The runners circled the track in a counterclockwise direction, not clockwise.
(跑者們沿著跑道逆時針方向而非順時針方向繞圈。)

clone(n./v.)複製品、複製生物、複製
cloning(n.)複製技術
human cloning 複製人技術
clone an animal 複製動物
Dolly the sheep was the first mammal to be cloned from an adult cell.
(桃莉羊是第一隻由成體細胞複製出來的哺乳動物。)
Many cheap smartphones are simply clones of popular brands.
(許多廉價智慧型手機只不過是知名品牌的仿製品。)

closure(n.)關閉、結束、了結
close(v.)關閉
road closure 道路封閉
school closure 停課、學校關閉
The road closure caused heavy traffic during rush hour.
(道路封閉在尖峰時段造成嚴重塞車。)
Talking with her ex-boyfriend helped her find closure.
(和前男友談過之後，她終於能夠釋懷。)

coalition(n.)聯盟、聯合政府
(無詞性變化)
coalition government 聯合政府
form a coalition 組成聯盟
The two parties formed a coalition after neither won a majority.
(兩黨在都沒有取得多數席次後組成了聯盟。)
A coalition of environmental groups protested against the new factory.
(環保團體聯盟抗議興建新工廠。)

coastline(n.)海岸線
coast(n.)海岸
rocky coastline 岩岸
along the coastline 沿著海岸線
We rode our bikes along the beautiful coastline of eastern Taiwan.
(我們沿著台灣東部美麗的海岸線騎腳踏車。)
Rising sea levels are slowly changing the island's coastline.
(海平面上升正慢慢改變島嶼的海岸線。)

collision(n.)碰撞、衝突
collide(v.)碰撞、衝突
head-on collision 迎面相撞
collision with 與…相撞
Three people were injured in a head-on collision on the highway.
(公路上一起迎面相撞的車禍造成三人受傷。)
The ship was badly damaged in a collision with an iceberg.
(那艘船與冰山相撞後嚴重受損。)

colloquial(adj.)口語的、白話的
colloquialism(n.)口語用語
colloquially(adv.)口語地
colloquial English 口語英文
colloquial expression 口語說法
'Gonna' is a colloquial form of 'going to' and should be avoided in formal writing.
('Gonna' 是 'going to' 的口語形式，在正式寫作中應避免使用。)
Watching TV dramas is a good way to learn colloquial English.
(看影集是學習口語英文的好方法。)

comet(n.)彗星
(無詞性變化)
Halley's Comet 哈雷彗星
comet tail 彗尾
Halley's Comet can be seen from Earth about every 76 years.
(從地球上大約每七十六年可以看到一次哈雷彗星。)
Astronomers discovered a new comet heading toward the sun.
(天文學家發現了一顆朝太陽前進的新彗星。)

commonplace(adj./n.)平凡的、常見的、司空見慣的事
(無詞性變化)
become commonplace 變得司空見慣
commonplace event 平常的事
Online classes, once rare, have now become commonplace.
(曾經少見的線上課程現在已經變得司空見慣。)
Electric scooters are now a commonplace sight in Taiwanese cities.
(電動機車如今在台灣城市中隨處可見。)

commonwealth(n.)聯邦、共和國、國協
(無詞性變化)
the Commonwealth (of Nations) 大英國協
Commonwealth Games 大英國協運動會
Canada and Australia are both members of the Commonwealth.
(加拿大與澳洲都是大英國協的成員。)
